angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 946,152 km at 193.78 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.1604 +/- 0.0125 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84): 193.78 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.36 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Thomas et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5786 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract): 946,152 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.23 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Thomas et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5786 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6235 +/- 50 K from Thomas et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5786 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Thomas et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5786 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5786.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.261, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-5786: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5786 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Thomas et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5786 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.39733, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5786 (pscomppars): age 2.5 Gyr, from Thomas et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5786 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 7 km/s, from Thomas et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract)
